title: Principal Concept Artist
description:
WHAT MAKES US EPIC?

At the core of Epic’s success are talented, passionate people. Epic prides itself on creating a collaborative, welcoming, and creative environment. Whether it’s building award-winning games or crafting engine technology that enables others to make visually stunning interactive experiences, we’re always innovating.

Being Epic means being a part of a team that continually strives to do right by our community and users. We’re constantly innovating to raise the bar of engine and game development.

ART What We Do

Push your artistic talent to the limit on a team of world-class environment, character and concept artists who strive to innovate and inspire.

What You'll Do

Epic is looking for a talented Principal Concept Artist to help us continue to shape the future of Fortnite. As Principal Concept Artist you will work with the development teams to create memorable environments along with unique and compelling characters that exude personality and style. You will use your artistic expertise in color, composition, shape, and visual design to help push our iconic visual style. Your craft expertise in both character and environment design will provide the inspiration which will continue to push the boundaries of what Fornite means to our players.

In this role, you will
  • Collaborate closely with the Art Directors and core development team to drive and visualize many different types of content across the Fortnite universe
  • Inspire, mentor, and manage a team of Concept Artists and outsourcing vendors
  • Provide timely & detailed feedback for the concept art team and outsourcing vendors
  • Coordinate with other art, design, and production teams to help accomplish the goals of the product
What we're looking for
  • Worked on at least one AAA game in a Lead or Principal Concept Artist role
  • Portfolio that demonstrates a range of styles, creativity and craftsmanship
  • Effective leader, collaborator, and problem solver able to coordinate with internal and external teams
  • Excellent organizational skills and ability to accurately estimate tasks and maintain schedules
  • Strong communication skills and understanding of various art disciplines (animation, character, environment, VFX)
  • Excellent traditional artistic skills with a strong grasp of composition, anatomy, color theory, perspective, lighting, environment, architectural, character, costume and graphic design
  • 7 + years experience in the game industry working in AAA game development
  • You’re user-focused, passionate, solutions-focused, and innovative. These traits equal success at Epic and influence everything we do
EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

We pay 100% for benefits for both employees (EEs) and dependents (deps). Our current benefits package includes coverage for medical, dental, and life insurance. We also offer supplemental benefits including daily meal vouchers, and commuter benefits for onsite employees.

ABOUT US

Epic Games spans across 25 countries with 46 studios and 4,500+ employees globally. For over 25 years, we've been making award-winning games and engine technology that empowers others to make visually stunning games and 3D content that bring environments to life like never before. Epic's award-winning Unreal Engine technology not only provides game developers the ability to build high-fidelity, interactive experiences for PC, console, mobile, and VR, it is also a tool being embraced by content creators across a variety of industries such as media and entertainment, automotive, and architectural design. As we continue to build our Engine technology and develop remarkable games, we strive to build teams of world-class talent.

Like what you hear? Come be a part of something Epic!

  • Ensure the execution of national and regional account strategies for all company products and achieve sales, profit and market share objectives for all national and regional accounts and/or programs.

Primary Purpose of the position: The Director, Operations manages operational processes from start to finish in the assigned plant. They work with their plant leadership teams to manage operations in the plant and achieve assigned production and operational goals according to budgeted plant targets and help drive culture and strategy to increase productivity and engagement.

Essential Responsible Areas:

  • Ensures plant performance is closely linked to customer requirements, product specifications and quality controls.
  • Confirms the plant complies with all environmental regulations by maintaining effective environmental programs.

  • Align with Manufacturing Cost Controller/Finance and manages the plant budget, cost per thousand and operating plans.

  • Responsible for the selection, training, growth and development of shift and staff personnel to attain organizational goals.

Establish a high performance culture and healthy and productive working relationships with the workforce.
  • Establish effective relationships with any key stakeholders (internal and external).

  • Manufacturing leadership experience (high speed manufacturing/packaging preferred).

  • Performs such individual assignments as management may direct.
  • Must follow company policies, procedures, practices, and standards of conduct as outlined in the Ball Corporation manuals.
  • Must maintain professional competence, ethical integrity, knowledge, and skills.

Ball Corporation is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We actively encourage applications from everybody. All qualified job applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, creed, national origin, aboriginality, genetic information, ancestry, marital status, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, physical or mental disability, pregnancy, veteran status, age, political affiliation or any other non-merit characteristic.

Join an industry leader and make a positive change in the sustainable use of the world’s natural resources. Together, we will transform the business and drive the industry toward a greener future.
At Metso, you will be supported by our inclusive culture and a network of colleagues from around the world. With us, you will embark on a personal growth journey and are encouraged to realize your potential. This is your invitation to rise above the possible.

Job posting end date: 08/17/2025

Introduction

We are seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer to join our Bulk Material Handling Product Engineering team. You will be responsible for leading engineering efforts for design new products, product upgrades, modifications, and new development (R&D) within our product portfolio. This role involves hands-on engineering and providing direct support during equipment breakdowns and repairs. Your expertise will play a crucial part in driving our global initiatives and ensuring the reliable operation and enhancement of critical mining equipment, contributing to the success of our global aftermarket business.

In this position, you will report to the Senior Manager of BMH Engineering.Based in Sorocaba, BR, requires approximately 10% travel annually. For more information on Metso’s bulk material handling service capabilities, click here .

Team You Belong To

You will join a global team of highly skilled mechanical engineers dedicated to the design, development, and support of bulk material handling equipment within the mining industry. We are focused on delivering innovative and reliable solutions that enhance the performance and lifespan of critical machinery such as Apron Feeders, Rotary Car Dumpers, and Bucketwheel Stacker Reclaimers.

We collaborate closely with internal teams such as the Field Service Team and external stakeholders across various regions. Our team culture emphasizes collaboration, innovation, and continuous improvement, with members located in multiple global locations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead the engineering and development of mechanical and structural systems for bulk material handling equipment.
  • Manage multiple projects from concept through execution, ensuring on-time and within-budget delivery.
  • Develop 3D models, shop drawings, specifications, and procedures for fabrication and assembly.
  • Conduct structural and mechanical calculations to ensure the safe and efficient operation of equipment.
  • Spearhead R&D initiatives for product development and design, integrating cutting-edge technologies.
  • Collaborate with the Field Service Team to provide engineering support during equipment breakdowns, minimizing downtime.
  • Work closely with the global engineering team to implement equipment upgrades, modifications, and repairs.
  • Ensure all engineering documentation meets industry standards and regulatory requirements.

Who You Are

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical Engineering or related field.
  • Preferably over ten years of experience in mechanical engineering, including exposure to bulk material handling equipment in the mining industry.
  • Proficiency in CAD software (AutoCAD, Inventor) and mechanical systems design.
  • Deep understanding of machine design, structural analysis, material selection, and manufacturing processes.
  • Proven experience diagnosing and resolving equipment breakdowns under time constraints.
  • Knowledge of BMH equipment such as Apron Feeders, Belt Feeders, and Rotary Car Dumpers.
  • Strong global collaboration experience and ability to work across cultures and regions.
  • Exceptional problem-solving skills with a proactive approach to overcoming complex engineering challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills in English.

What's in it for you

At BMH, we offer an exciting work environment where engineers can truly thrive. Here's why you should consider joining our team:

  • Engaging Technical Challenges: If you love tackling complex problems, you'll fit right in. Every day brings new challenges—from managing breakdowns and shutdowns to upgrading old machinery and designing solutions for both legacy and cutting-edge equipment. You'll also have the opportunity to develop new products that make a real impact.
  • Global Reach and Diverse Projects: Our work isn't confined to one location or one type of problem. As part of our division that supports clients worldwide, you could be solving a mechanical issue in Mongolia one day and addressing a system upgrade in Chile the next. The variety keeps your work engaging and broadens your professional horizons.
  • Collaborative Global Team: You'll be part of a truly global team with specialists in diverse areas spread across England, Denmark, the United States, Australia, India, Brazil, Chile, and Peru. When you face a challenge, you can be confident that someone in our group has the expertise to support you. Collaboration and mutual support are at the heart of our culture.
  • Top-Notch Resources: We equip our engineers with the best tools and the most comprehensive knowledge about our equipment. This ensures you have everything you need to perform at your best and continue growing professionally.
  • Extensive Legacy Portfolio: Having acquired more than 40 companies, we boast a vast legacy portfolio with over 80 different pieces of equipment. This diversity not only enriches your experience but also provides endless opportunities to learn and innovate.

Get in touch

Want to rise above the possible with us? Click ‘Apply Now’ to submit your application. In your application, please highlight your experience with bulk material handling equipment—this will catch our attention. Please note: We cannot provide relocation assistance for this position..

We understand that some highly capable candidates might hesitate to apply for a role unless they meet every listed qualification. If you're excited about this role, we encourage you to apply even if you don't meet all the requirements. You may be the right candidate for the role.

Job Description

Se você sempre sonhou em trabalhar em uma das empresas que mais emprega no Brasil, que está em constante transformação e investe em projetos de inovação, essa é sua chance!

Nosso maior desafio é promover e liderar a transformação do modelo de operação e manutenção de redes de Telecom, aportando tecnologia, revisando procedimentos, otimizando recursos e, principalmente, investindo na capacitação e no desenvolvimento dos nossos colaboradores. Sua missão será:

Liderar equipes em serviços de obras de telecomunicações na rede subterrânea e em projetos de energia solar, distribuindo, acompanhando as atividades das equipes na instalação, manutenção e adensamento de redes de telecomunicações e projetos de energia solar, além da execução de projetos de retirada e adensamento na rede subterrânea de telecomunicações, projetar, vistoriar, realizar içamento e fixação de painéis solares. Se interessou? Venha trabalhar em uma empresa que conecta pessoas!

title: Senior Cost Controller
description:
The Cost Optimization team is responsible for identifying cost reduction opportunities within Brazil Operations without compromising safety or service quality.

Brazil Operations is a critical business unit for SBM Offshore’s cash flow, handling 20-30% of Brazil’s oil production.

The cost structure of Brazil Operations is heavily focused on maintenance activities that ensure FPSOs (Floating Production Storage and Offloading units) can operate for up to 25 years in remote ocean locations, ensuring equipment reliability and the integrity of hulls and tanks.

The Senior Cost Controller will be a key player in this strategic initiative, requiring a blend of strategic vision and strong skills in modeling and data analysis.

RESPONSIBILITIES

  1. Understand the cost structure of Brazil Operations to identify areas of high expenditure within the P&L.
  2. Identify and prioritize cost-reduction opportunities by assessing financial feasibility (business cases), developing projections/forecasts, and maximizing returns.
  3. Lead or collaborate on cost-reduction projects with internal teams (e.g., Supply Chain, HR, Maintenance), providing critical analysis of both cost and performance data that impacts costs (e.g., productivity). This includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs), data gathering, insights generation, proposing improvements, and influencing business transformation.
  4. Improve cost tracking processes by generating regular optimization reports using internal systems (e.g., ERP). Take responsibility for data from source to transformation, including dashboard creation and data flow automation. Ensure data consistency, quality, and governance, collaborating with IT.
  5. Support communication initiatives to raise awareness among employees about the importance of cost management, linking it to the company’s long-term strategy.

REQUIREMENTS

  1. Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related fields.
  2. An MBA or a master’s degree in finance is highly desirable.
  3. Solid experience in consulting, cost optimization, cost analysis, financial efficiency, corporate finance, financial modeling, project valuation, strategic planning, data intelligence, data analytics, business intelligence, or process optimization.
  4. Fluent in both Portuguese and English (written and spoken).
  5. Experience with databases modeling tools (e.g., Access, Alteryx, Power Pivot/Power Query, ETL, Star Schema, OLAP, master data management, cubes, or similar), managing large datasets.
  6. Basic knowledge in the following (no professional experience required): SQL or any programming language.
  7. Project valuation and business cases (e.g., ROI, NPV).
  8. Key financial reports (balance sheet, income statement, and cash flow).
  9. Basic knowledge of the Oil and Gas industry is desirable.
  10. Familiarity with Maintenance Strategy and Integrity concepts is a plus.

O SBT, com o objetivo de continuar a compartilhar alegria, entretenimento e informação aos nossos espectadores, está sempre em busca de novos SBTistas para fazerem parte da nossa família!

Se você se identifica com a nossa cultura, mas não encontrou a sua vaga dos sonhos, deixe seu currículo com a gente!

Somos o SBT

Em 19 de agosto de 1981, foi inaugurado o Sistema Brasileiro de Televisão, o SBT. Considerado o canal da família brasileira, o SBT cobre mais de 187 milhões de telespectadores e 66,7 milhões de lares.

Atualmente conta com 118 emissoras em todo o país, com 24 horas de programação diversificada, com participação de 9,2% na Grande São Paulo e 8,1% nas Regiões Metropolitanas.

O complexo do SBT em São Paulo tem uma área total de 230.000m² com 74.000m² de área construída. Conta com oito estúdios, somando uma área de mais de 4.400 m² e uma cidade cenográfica de 6.500 m².

O SBT é sucesso consolidado em programas de auditório, referência na produção de conteúdo infanto-juvenil, conta com jornalismo imparcial e de credibilidade, além de forte presença no digital, com conteúdos exclusivos. Estamos em constante evolução, reafirmando, cada vez mais, o nosso espaço no ambiente digital, com projetos modernos como SBT Games, TV Zyn, +SBT, SBT Ads, SBT do Bem, SBTNews e diversos podcasts. Estas inovações tornam o SBT uma produtora de conteúdo relevante e confiável para os espectadores em qualquer tela.

Cerca de 3 mil colaboradores por todo o Brasil fazem essa história acontecer todos os dias, vivendo os nossos pilares em um ambiente familiar e divertido.

description:
Você conhece a Bunge?

Desde 02/07/2025, a Bunge e a Viterra foram combinadas e se tornaram uma só empresa. Nossos cerca de 37.000 colaboradores — que são a força que impulsiona o nosso sucesso — estão dedicados a um único objetivo: conectar agricultores a consumidores para fornecer alimentos, ingredientes para nutrição animal e combustíveis essenciais para o mundo. Como uma empresa recém-combinada, somos orientados por nossos valores compartilhados em tudo o que fazemos:

- Somos um só time

- Lideramos o caminho

- Fazemos o que é certo

Somos apaixonados, ousados e determinados. Juntos, lideramos a geração de valor para nossos clientes, para nós mesmos e para o mundo. Enquanto trabalhamos para integrar nossas oportunidades de trabalho, os candidatos são incentivados a explorar as vagas publicadas em nome da Bunge e da Viterra.

Descrição do cargo:

Operar equipamentos de baldeio de menor complexidade e equipamentos auxiliares. Acompanhar as correias para observar a manutenção dos fluxos dos produtos. Realizar serviços gerais de limpeza e conservação das áreas de armazenagem e pátio. Auxiliar nas inspeções antes das descargas dos veículos, bem como coletar amostras para análise e fazer os registros em formulários apropriados. Auxiliar em inspeções nos pátios com o objetivo de monitorar os níveis e as condições de armazenagem dos estoques. Preencher relatórios anotando os dados, ocorrências e informações dos trabalhos efetuados. Zelar pela manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos utilizados e local de trabalho.

Principais Atividades:

  • Operar equipamentos de baldeio de menor complexidade e equipamentos auxiliares, executando as atividades que envolvam serviços de carga e descarga de veículos, vagões ou embarcações marítimas.
  • Acompanhar as correias para observar a manutenção dos fluxos dos produtos.
  • Apoiar nas operações fabris e fornecer dados para a conferência dos volumes no recebimento, estocagem, remoção, transporte e embarque.
  • Realizar serviços gerais de limpeza e conservação das áreas de armazenagem e pátio, para a manutenção e qualidade do ambiente de trabalho.
  • Auxiliar nas inspeções antes das descargas dos veículos, bem como coletar amostras para análise e fazer os registros em formulários apropriados, tomando ações em caso de não conformidades.
  • Auxiliar em inspeções nos pátios com o objetivo de monitorar os níveis e as condições de armazenagem dos estoques, de acordo com as normas de segurança e meio ambiente.
  • Movimentar os tipos de produtos conforme a demanda, identificando o melhor equipamento ou ferramenta para execução do trabalho.
  • Preencher relatórios anotando os dados, ocorrências e informações dos trabalhos efetuados, registrando a natureza da intervenção e materiais utilizados.
  • Zelar pela manutenção e limpeza dos equipamentos utilizados e local de trabalho.
  • Cumprir os procedimentos de Segurança do Trabalho, mediante a participação em palestras e treinamentos, utilização de EPI´s, manuseio adequado de máquinas e equipamentos, dentre outras.
  • Cumprir com suas responsabilidades no sistema de gestão de qualidade e segurança dos alimentos, atendendo aos requisitos, participando dos treinamentos, relatando os problemas observados, cumprindo com as Boas Práticas de Fabricação, Transporte e Armazenagem, 5’s, procedimentos operacionais e do sistema de gestão.
  • Conhecer e apoiar a política de qualidade e segurança dos alimentos assim como os KPI’s estabelecidos.
  • Participar, caso o colaborador seja integrante da Equipe de Segurança de Alimentos (ESA), ativamente das reuniões, revisão do estudo HACCP, treinamentos, bem como outras responsabilidades definidas e cumprir e incentivar aos demais colaboradores todas as práticas de Segurança de Alimentos.
  • Monitorar, caso seja um controlador de PCC e PPRO, conforme planejado, em caso de desvio acionar imediatamente a liderança e garantir a tomada de ação imediata e corretiva.
  • Seguir o protocolo definido e ser independente durante o processo, não responder ao seu superior imediato. caso o colaborador seja responsável pela coleta de produtos para análises do escopo GMP+.
  • Fazer uso das informações provenientes de medidores de parâmetros de qualidade on line, e para os pontos de inspeções onde não há essa disponibilidade, realizar a coleta de amostras, para as análises realizadas em laboratório, de forma representativa, permitindo que os resultados obtidos auxiliem no controle e melhoria dos processos e qualidade dos produtos.

Requisitos:

  • Ensino médio completo;
  • Desejável Noçoes de informática básica.

Veja também nossos benefícios:

  • Seguro de Vida

  • Programa “Conte com a gente” - P rograma de orientação e apoio pessoal para colaboradores e dependentes. Realizado por profissionais especializados, com objetivo de apoiar com assuntos Psicológicos, Sociais ou Emocionais.
  • Parcerias com TotalPass (Academia), Clube MMB (Seguros individuais), Dell, além de Universidades e Escolas de Idiomas.

description:
Why SoftwareOne?

O sucesso na SoftwareOne não é definido pelo que você faz, mas pelo que você entrega para nossos clientes, para o negócio e para os colaboradores ao seu redor. Os colaboradores da SoftwareOne são enérgicos , ágeis e focados em proporcionar Satisfação ao Cliente e resultados de nível mundial. Nossos 8.700 funcionários apoiam nossos aproximadamente 65.000 clientes em sua transformação digital.


The role

Junte-se à nossa equipe de vendas! Estamos ansiosos para aprender mais sobre você e explorar como, trabalhando juntos, podemos formar uma equipe excepcional.

Account Manager

Hunter SAP
Vaga: CLT | Modelo: hibrido | Localização: Sao Paulo

Um Gerente de Contas na SoftwareOne é responsável por identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios, trazendo o melhor das soluções da SoftwareOne para atender às necessidades dos clientes e criando um pipeline robusto de leads qualificados. Responsável por todo o processo de vendas, desde a identificação da oportunidade até a conversão, desempenhando um papel fundamental no crescimento da receita da organização.

Como vai ser o seu dia a dia:

  • Identificar e desenvolver novas oportunidades de negócios.
  • Realizar uma análise detalhada dos requisitos e pontos de dor do cliente.
  • Utilizar conhecimento aprofundado das ofertas de produtos para articular a proposta de valor.
  • Implementar estratégias proativas de prospecção e geração de leads.
  • Cultivar relacionamentos sólidos com os principais tomadores de decisão e influenciadores.

What we need to see from you

O que esperamos de você:

Experiência plena/avancada em:

  • Vender soluções técnicas complexas, modelos de consumo e resultados de negócios para a alta gerência do cliente e suas equipes.
  • Grande conhecimento no portfólio SAP e conhecimento no ecossistema.
  • Desenvolver planos de contas acionáveis a curto e longo prazo, baseados em uma compreensão profunda dos impactos das tendências de negócios e tecnologia.
  • Vender novos softwares e serviços em nível empresarial global.
  • Demonstrar profundo conhecimento do setor de gerenciamento de desempenho ou análise, incluindo produtos, concorrentes, histórico, tendências emergentes e mudanças no mercado.
  • Possuir experiência em diversas indústrias verticais e suas tendências, combinada com conhecimento em TI/OT, bem como serviços de nuvem e plataforma.

Qualificações Desejáveis:

  • Inglês avançado
  • Certificações SAP

Habilidades comportamentais:

  • Trabalho em equipe: trabalha efetivamente dentro da equipe global, alcançando metas individuais e apoiando os colegas de equipe.
  • Foco no cliente: garante estar ciente das necessidades e expectativas do cliente, buscando constantemente fornecer um desempenho de classe mundial.
  • Motivar, orientar e desenvolver colegas de equipe e todo o Ecossistema, como CSMs, CSEs, PSSs, arquitetos, engenheiros de sistemas e GAMs de entrada global.
  • Excelentes habilidades de comunicação e interpessoais.

Na SoftwareOne, estamos comprometidos em oferecer um ambiente de respeito mútuo, onde oportunidades de emprego iguais estão disponíveis para todos os candidatos e colegas, sem distinção de raça, cor, religião, idade, sexo, origem nacional, status de deficiência, genética, orientação sexual, identidade de gênero, expressão, ou qualquer outra característica.

Aviso: Esta postagem de emprego é para oportunidades futuras e não é destinada à contratação imediata. Estamos sempre à procura de indivíduos talentosos para se juntar à nossa equipe e incentivamos você a enviar sua candidatura. Ao se candidatar, você consente que suas informações sejam armazenadas em nosso banco de talentos para possíveis futuras vagas que correspondam às suas habilidades e experiência. Agradecemos seu interesse e entraremos em contato se uma posição adequada estiver disponível.

  • Collaborate with cross-functional leaders to optimize deal processes, improve efficiency, and enhance the revenue operation
  • Provide guidance and mentorship to team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and development

  • Collaborate with revenue leadership and contribute to the overall revenue strategy and objectives

Reconhecemos que ainda há trabalho a ser feito e não vamos parar até que todas as pessoas que passem pelas nossas portas diariamente se sintam incluídas. Venha fazer parte da nossa história!

What You'll Bring:

  • Experiência com manipulação de dados: Business Intelligence, Data Quality, Data Governance, Ciência de Dados, Análise de Dados.
  • Conhecimento e experiência em Governança de Dados utilizando frameworks atuais (DAMA, CMMi DMM ou DCAM).
  • Capacidade prática de analisar grandes quantidades de dados, reconhecer padrões e tendências e organizar observações em um formato claro e útil.

  • Liderar projetos de governança de dados com atuação cross nas diversas áreas de dados.
  • Coletar, analisar e sintetizar as informações de uma variedade de conjuntos de dados grandes e/ou complexos para entender o comportamento dos dados de pessoas consumidoras.

  • Manter contato com a equipe Global da TransUnion para adequação de processos e uso de ferramentas globais.
  • Monitorar os dashboards e processo de qualidade de dados, endereçando as ações de melhoria junto ao time de soluções.

title: Market Director, Latin America
description:
About CDP:

CDP is a global non-profit that runs the world’s only independent environmental disclosure system. As the founder of environmental reporting, we believe in transparency and the power of data to drive change.

Partnering with leaders in enterprise, capital, policy and science, we surface the information needed to enable Earth-positive decisions. We helped more than 24,800 companies and almost 1,000 cities, states and regions disclose their environmental impacts in 2024. Financial institutions with more than a quarter of the world’s institutional assets use CDP data to help inform investment and lending decisions.

Our team is truly global, united by our shared desire to build a world where people, planet and profit are balanced. Visit cdp.net or follow us @CDP to find out more.

About the Team:

CDP’s Sales function is responsible for generating sales of CDP products to new customers, as well as renewing existing customers and identifying greenfield opportunities within the existing book of business. The Sales function is market and customer oriented and establishes go-to market strategies that serve key personas across financial corporates, non-financial corporates, and distributors and channels. The Sales function works closely with M&C and Customer Success to deliver a smooth customer experience.

Key relationship management function in market, overseeing the renewals book of business and identifying greenfield opportunities to expand relationships with existing customers.

About this role:

As a CDP Market Director, you will have dual responsibilities: serving as the Sub-Regional Market Head and leading the Relationship Management function. In your role as Sub-Regional Head, you will be the senior market-facing representative, engaging with customers at the most senior level and representing CDP at events. Additionally, you will operate within a matrixed organizational structure, providing leadership and guidance to the team. Leading the relationship management function, you will oversee renewals, responsible for the custody and cultivation of the existing book of business.

What you will do:

Manage an effective and engaged team, clear on its purpose and contribution, by:

  • Working with the Talent Attraction team to identify and recruit the right talent to the team
  • Providing focus and direction, through regular 1:1’s, setting clear objectives, providing ongoing, honest feedback, recognition, structured performance and development conversations, and helping with solutions
  • Ensuring a respectful and inclusive workplace, where team members can communicate openly, share knowledge so it can be used, and respect difference. Help resolve conflict as appropriate
  • Living the CDP Values and demonstrating the behaviours appropriate to their position

Strategic Growth Planning:

  • Collaborate with the CRO to develop a comprehensive strategic growth plan focused on revenue-generating activities for the region. This plan should align with the overall business objectives and drive sustainable growth

Cross-Functional Collaboration:

  • Foster seamless collaboration among Sales team members (business development and relationship managers), Customer Success teams (under CDO), and Marketing & Communications (under CMO) to ensure an exceptional client experience. This includes facilitating effective communication and coordination across departments.

Net Renewal Rate (NRR) Achievement:

  • Achieve the sub-regional Net Renewal Rate (NRR) budget by providing tactical advice and support to Relationship Management teams. This involves analyzing performance metrics and implementing strategies to improve client retention.

Go-to-Market (GTM) Execution:

  • Execute go-tomarket (GTM) initiatives effectively, ensuring that all activities are aligned with the strategic growth plan and market demands.

External Representation:

  • Represent CDP at key external events, including speaking engagements at conferences. This role requires strong public speaking skills and the ability to articulate CDP's value proposition to diverse audiences.

Market and Competitive Analysis:

  • Maintain an up-to-date understanding of the competitive landscape, market trends, and client feedback. This includes conducting regular market research and using insights to inform strategic decisions.

Leadership Participation:

  • Actively participate in and contribute to CDP leadership groups. This involves collaborating with senior leaders to shape the organization's strategic direction.

Global System Integration:

  • Ensure CDP's role within the global system by providing local context and aiding in the development of global organizational strategies. This includes sharing regional insights and best practices with global counterparts

Fundraising and Development Support:

  • Support local fundraising and development efforts in alignment with global priorities and strategies. This involves identifying potential funding opportunities and building relationships with key stakeholders.

Regional Strategy Development:

  • Collaborate with other country and regional offices to develop regional strategies and share best practices. This includes fostering a culture of continuous improvement and innovation.

Behavioural Traits and Values:

  • Embody and promote CDP's core values of moving together, finding solutions, transparency and optimism. These values should guide all interactions and decision-making processes, ensuring a positive and forward-thinking organizational culture.

The types of roles managed might include relationship managers for financial and nonfinancial corporates.

Internal stakeholders include: disclosure request, disclosure, signatory and data delivery, rev ops, M&C, business development colleagues, impact/TL, policy.

External stakeholders include: corporate and nonfinancial corporates.

This role is a budget holder for renewal of corporate and non-financial corporates.

We're looking for:

  • Extensive and proven experience working in commercial organizations in leadership of sales and account management.
  • Proven track record of developing strong strategic client/stakeholder relationships with financial and non-financial corporates.
  • A strong network of contacts you can use to advance the deep and longstanding relationships CDP holds.
  • Proven track record of creating and implementing strategies to deliver on business and/or impact targets.
  • Background in and knowledge of local business, policy, and sustainability culture, with a known reputation in this sector.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills.
  • Relevant degree qualification or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent in at least one local language

Somos uma empresa em construção, então aqui o aprendizado é constante e você terá pista livre para criar e muitos (muitos mesmo!) desafios . Além disso, você trabalhará ao lado de pessoas diversas e talentosas que irão te ajudar a usar todo o seu potencial e gerar o maior impacto possível.

  • Liberdade para trilhar uma carreira protagonista;
  • Espaço para desenvolvimento e aprendizado constantes.

// Sobre o ambiente de trabalho, é importante você saber que:

  • Nossa cultura de mente aberta torna o ambiente horizontal para que as decisões sejam tomadas com base em fatos e dados, colocando os interesses dos clientes sempre em primeiro lugar.

O nosso modelo de trabalho varia de acordo com a função: preferencialmente presencial para frentes de negócio, predominantemente remoto para times de tecnologia e híbrido para as demais equipes. title: Senior Biodiversity Expert
description:
ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;

  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.

  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.

  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.

  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.

  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.

ABOUT ERM:

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

(DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

A diretriz primordial da Associação é sua inserção no sistema de saúde direcionada ao tratamento, prevenção de doenças e à promoção da saúde primária, secundária e terciária, estreitando laços com a comunidade local e reafirmando seu compromisso social de atender a todos, sem discriminação.

Assim, a SPDM contribui de forma efetiva para a melhoria contínua dos serviços prestados pelo Sistema Único de Saúde do Brasil, visando principalmente garantir a universalidade e as oportunidades de acesso à saúde, necessárias ao desenvolvimento humano e social do cidadão.

Nosso compromisso é promover uma cultura de inclusão da diversidade, que capacita nossos colaboradores a contribuir com o seu melhor. A SPDM é uma empregadora de igualdade de oportunidades de emprego para todas as pessoas que assim atendam os requisitos mínimos.

Principal / Sr Principal – for Pharma HQ in Switzerland
IQVIA is The Human Data Science Company, focused on using data and science to help healthcare clients find better solutions for their patients. IQVIA offers a broad range of solutions that harness advances in healthcare information, technology, analytics and human ingenuity to drive healthcare forward.
To help our clients navigate a wide range of challenges, we are looking for talented, senior leaders to join our team of entrepreneurial problem-solvers in Switzerland.
We are a global team working with leading life science organisations and innovative biotechs to diagnose critical business issues, co-create evidence-based solutions and realise tangible impact in our clients’ organisations, for the benefit of patients.
We are a team of strategic thinkers, ensuring our client is at the centre of what we do, bringing together the required expertise from across IQVIA. We are successful because we are collaborative, curious, and disruptive.
Whether your background is more in real world evidence, market access, medical affairs, commercial strategy, or data analytics, we are interested in all team players who have a relentless client-first mindset and problem-solving skillset.
Why Join?

  • Become part of a recognized global leader in life science services and solutions, still willing to challenge the status quo to improve patient care.
  • Closely partner with leading companies to answer the toughest industry problems with the largest data sets, best-in-class experts and cutting-edge technology.
  • Continue to expand your skillset by getting involved in a wide range of different types of projects or deepen your expertise by specialising in your sweet spot.
  • Keep developing your career with an organization that allows you to embrace your passions and invests into continuous professional and personal growth.
  • Close mentorship to enable you to challenge yourself with stretch opportunities.
Work in a flexible hybrid model that combines in-office and at-client days, as well as permitting working from home.
The Role
As a Principal / Sr Principal within our team, you will take on a variety of roles within the following core areas: business development, client relationship building, project leadership, team development.
The role requires an inquisitive, consulting mindset to develop new opportunities, alongside a customer-first mentality to grow long-term partnerships with headquarters clients. Working closely with other go-to-market team members, you will engage with a diverse mix of client stakeholders to identify their needs and develop custom solutions across the life sciences value chain.
Responsibilities
  • Build client intimacy with key stakeholders at key accounts to drive business development opportunities within specific practice areas as well as for the broader IQVIA business.
  • Help establish or further embed IQVIA as a trusted partner for the client, across functional and geographic areas in a coordinated, ‘One IQVIA’ go-to-market approach.
  • Meet or exceed assigned sales/revenue targets by proactively engaging with clients to create business development opportunities for IQVIA.
  • Act as principal owner of both client relationships, proposals and engagements; ultimate responsibility for delivering high quality/added value in e.very project and client satisfaction.
  • Allocate direction, advice, and intellectual leadership to clients and delivery teams.
  • Provide input and ensure development of client reports and presentations.
  • Ability to deliver all or significant portions of findings to clients.
  • Provide follow-up with clients after project deliverables have been completed to ensure client satisfaction and continued engagement.
  • Lead thought leadership and firm building initiatives and contribute to the enhanced awareness of IQVIA consulting services in the marketplace, e.g. through speaking engagements, client meetings, and publications.
  • Mentor, coach, and share feedback and subject matter expertise with others to help develop individuals and capabilities delivering world-class solutions for clients.
  • Participate in annual performance review team processes as requried.
  • Engage in recruitment and selection of new staff.
Desired Skills And Experience
  • Significant part of previous experience gained in selling / BD roles within consulting / professional services in Life Science.
  • Expertise in various of the following domains: real-world evidence, medical affairs, HEOR, market access, commercial strategy and operations, data science and analytics.
  • Strong interest and experience in developing and delivering innovative solutions across the product lifecycle.
  • Proven success in selling complex and/or strategic engagements to HQ / Global level.
  • A track record in building client relationships, ideally including experience of account strategy.
  • Commercial awareness, including experience in balancing scope management and client relationship to ensure commercial objectives are met.
  • Strong analytical problem-solving skills and a solution-orientated mindset.
  • Offerings’ development experience – familiarity with accepted innovations models e.g., open innovation, ideation, product platforming, immersion or similar would be beneficial.
  • Proven ability to advance ambiguous or conceptual ideas to decision points, while engaging multiple stakeholders, internal and clients.
  • Experience in managing virtual teams and enabling individuals to perform, grow and deliver client work to high-quality and standards.
  • Excellent interpersonal and networking skills. Values people’s opinions and encourages knowledge sharing.
  • Previous experience in coaching junior team-members, ideally in a formal coaching role.
  • Leadership experience in complex organizations with demonstrated results in aligning people without formal reporting relationships.
Your Behaviours
Regardless of your background or your functional expertise, we are on the lookout for experienced team members who will live the below behaviours on a daily basis:

  • Client centricity
  • Delivery excellence
  • Partnership
  • Empowerment
  • Coaching
In addition to the skills and experience above a Principal should have:
  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent, graduate degree or MBA not required but advantageous
  • Fluency in English (spoken and written)
  • A willingness and ability to travel
  • Right to live and work in the European Union and/or the United Kingdom
Benefits
We work hard to prioritise the things that matter most to you. Visit our benefits page for information on everything from perks to well-being initiatives and career enhancement.

title: Senior Biodiversity Expert
description:
ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;

  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.

  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.

  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.

  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.

  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.

ABOUT ERM:

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

(DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

Infrastructure
We deploy long-term capital through direct, and fund investments across the capital structure to diversify our portfolio. You will help to preserve and enhance the value of our direct private and public equity investments, working with top management teams and board of directors.

The Sao Paulo team was established in 2015, and currently has nine investment professionals. The team is focused on analyzing opportunities in South and Central America, as well as managing the investments made since 2013 in the region. It is integrated into the global team which operates from London, New York, Singapore and Sao Paulo.

Illustrative investments include Aegea (water and sanitation in Brazil), CART/Eixo SP (toll roads in Brazil), V.tal (fiber optics in Brazil), Neoenergia Transmission (power transmission in Brazil), NTS (gas pipeline in Brazil) and Isagen (power generation in Colombia), amongst others. GIC Infrastructure approaches investments with a buy and hold perspective and manages assets with a long-term perspective. We focus on minority / co-control investments alongside industrial and financial partners and have consolidated ourselves as one of the most active investors in the sector and region.

We are looking for a suitable candidate to join our Sao Paulo team as an Analyst. GIC desires to become the leading long term global infrastructure investor and an outstanding career path is available for high performers.
What impact can you make in this role
You will be part of a team that invests into infrastructure companies with stable and predictable cash flows, reasonable risk-adjusted returns and strong impact to local economies.

What you will do as an Analyst
• Play a central role in growing GIC Infrastructure’s portfolio and supporting existing investments in the region.
• Under the supervision of the senior team, play an integral role in the full deal lifecycle: deal screening, approvals, execution, asset management and, when appropriate, exits.
• Take on primary role in the financial modeling of transactions, deal with senior management, external advisors and banks.
• Play a key part in deal screening and appraisal, contributing to transaction analysis, and helping prepare the documentation to support investment decisions to investment committee.
• Investment focus is likely to be biased towards, but not limited to, the power, midstream, transportation, digital infrastructure and water utility sectors. No experience in infrastructure sectors is required, but the candidate will be required to conduct financial research on public and private companies for potential acquisitions.
• The team operates in a flat and meritocratic culture, empowering staff with open communications and robust challenges. Being a team player and interacting with counterparties in a way that builds on our reputation is everyone’s responsibility.
What makes you a successful candidate?
• Bachelor’s degree from a top-tier university with coursework emphasizing business administration, economics, accounting, finance, and/or engineering. Graduation date between June 2024 and June 2025.
• Previous experience working for a private equity fund, institutional investors, or for investment banks as part of the M&A advisory or Equity research team. Experience in the infrastructure sector is not required.
• Outstanding financial modelling skills are assumed and will be tested. The ability to build models from scratch is required, as well as model review and scenario development.
• You will be detail-oriented with a hands-on attitude to deal execution and will thrive in a culture of high-expectations and personal responsibility to own the investment.
• Strong commercial and intellectual curiosity is a requirement to perform well and advance.
Work at the Point of Impact
We need to be forward-looking to attract the right people to help us become the Leading Global Long-Term Investor. Join our ambitious, agile, and diverse teams - be empowered to push boundaries and pursue innovative ideas, share your views, and be heard. Be anchored on our PRIME Values: Prudence, Respect, Integrity, Merit and Excellence, which guides us in how we make our day-to-day decisions. We strive to inspire. To make an impact.

At GIC, our offices are vibrant hubs for ideation, professional growth, and interpersonal connection. Thus, our teams come into the office at least four days per week to harness the benefits of in-person collaboration but have the flexibility to choose which days they work from home and adjust this arrangement as situational needs arise.

description:
Do you enjoy using science to drive change in the world?

About our Team

The Lancet Regional Health – Americas is an open access journal, part of the Lancet's global initiative to advocate for health-care quality and access in all regions of the world. We are an international team, handling high-quality research, reviews, commissions and commentaries to drive thought leadership across all areas of clinical and global public health pertaining to the WHO Americas region. You will take ownership of overseeing submissions and performing quality peer review to ensure we publish high-quality content. You will build international relationships with experts in the community to disseminate and discuss practice-changing results from the field.

In our pursuit of excellence, we recognise the strength in varied perspectives, experiences, and backgrounds. As part of our ongoing efforts to enhance the diversity of our editorial team, we encourage applications from individuals who bring unique skills, backgrounds, and perspectives to the role.

This is a full-time, fixed term position.

· Collaborating with colleagues to improve internal policies and processes

· Liaising with other editors, authors, and production teams to perfect papers for publication

· Exceptional organizational skills, capable of managing multiple projects and strict deadlines efficiently.

· Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English; public engagement and outreach experience is highly desirable.

· Have a genuine commitment to advancing equity in health and healthcare, with a thorough understanding of social and clinical issues relevant to the Americas.

· Ability to build relationships across diverse communities and to communicate complex scientific concepts to varied audiences.

Work in a way that works for you

· Working remotely from home and at our office in a hybrid working style

· Working flexible hours - flexing the times you work in the day

Working with us

We are an equal opportunity employer with a commitment to help you succeed. Here, you will find an inclusive, agile, collaborative, innovative and fun environment, where everyone has a part to play. A global leader in information and analytics, we help researchers and healthcare professionals advance science and improve health outcomes for the benefit of society. title: Senior Biodiversity Expert
description:
ERM is looking for a Senior Biodiversity Consultant in São Paulo, Rio de Janeiro, Belo Horizonte, Porto Alegre or Salvador.

Key responsabilities:

  • Lead biodiversity baseline studies, critical habitat assessments, and ecosystem services evaluations to inform project planning and conservation strategies.

  • Lead vegetation suppression processes, from field to reports elaboration;

  • Identify and assess project-related risks and impacts on species, habitats, and ecosystem functions, applying the mitigation hierarchy to avoid, minimize, and restore biodiversity loss.

  • Prepare technical documentation, including biotic environmental sections of Environmental and Social Impact Assessments (ESIAs), and compliance reports for regulators and financial institutions.

  • Ensure alignment with IFC Performance Standard 6 (PS6), IUCN guidelines, Business and Biodiversity Offsets Programme (BBOP) principles, and relevant national regulations.

  • Develop and implement Biodiversity Action Plans (BAPs), including offset strategies where necessary, to achieve measurable conservation outcomes.

  • Design and oversee biodiversity monitoring programs, including Key Biodiversity Indicators (KBIs), to track ecological performance and inform adaptive management.

  • Integrate nature-related risks, dependencies, and opportunities into project decision-making and reporting, in line with the Taskforce on Nature-related Financial Disclosures (TNFD) framework.

Qualifications & Experience:

  • Degree in Biology, Ecology, or a related field.

  • At least 8 years of experience in biodiversity assessment, management, and conservation planning.

  • Demonstrated expertise in applying IFC Performance Standard 6 (including Critical Habitat Assessments, Biodiversity Action Plans and biodiversity offsets) and integrating nature-related risk frameworks such as TNFD.

  • Proficient in GIS, remote sensing, and biodiversity data platforms (e.g., IBAT, STAR, IUCN Red List).

  • Strong analytical and synthesis skills, with excellent written and verbal communication.

  • Experience working in biodiversity-sensitive regions is highly desirable.

  • Excellent writing skills in both Portuguese and English.

  • Ability to remain composed under pressure and adapt to the dynamic nature of consultancy work.

  • Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel as required.

ABOUT ERM:

Environmental Resources Management (ERM) is a leading global provider of environmental, health, safety, risk, social consulting services and sustainability related services. We have more than 160 offices in over 40 countries and territories employing more than 8,000 people who work on projects around the world. ERM is committed to providing a service that is consistent, professional and of the highest quality to create value for our clients.We have worked with many of the Global Fortune 500 companies delivering innovative solutions for business and selected government clients helping them understand and manage the sustainability challenges that the world is increasingly facing.

For over 50 years we have been working with clients around the world and in diverse industry sectors to help them to understand and manage their environmental, health, safety, risk and social impacts. The key sectors we serve include Oil & Gas, Mining, Power, and Manufacturing, Chemical and Pharmaceutical. All face critical sustainability challenges and our clients in these and many other areas rely on our ability to assist them operate more sustainably which has a positive impact on our planet.

At ERM we know that creating a diverse, equitable and inclusive work environment is an essential part of making our company a great place to build a career.

(DEIB) at ERM, you can visit our website , or read about our progress in the 2024 Sustainability Report .

They should be able to communicate with various departments and teams to ensure that any pipeline we build is done so in close collaboration with the many other talented teams at Epic Games across the organization. EPIC JOB + EPIC BENEFITS = EPIC LIFE

  • Post incident activities:

title: API Analyst 1
description:
Overview

Job Description

  • An API Analyst is responsible for fielding and resolving issues related to the company's APIs by using internal systems troubleshooting tools and support processes. This position requires close communication with customers, partners, and other internal departments while maintaining issue ownership.

This position is onsite at our São Paulo, Brazil office.

What you will be doing

  • Troubleshoot and resolve basic API issues utilizing company systems, tools, and support processes with assistance and direct oversight from team members.
  • Be accountable for customer requests; maintain ownership of requests and follow through consistently with resolution.
  • Provide regular and frequent communication to customers; ensure customers are fully aware of the status of the issue.
  • Compose internal documentation that fully reflects all activity related to the resolution of API support requests.
  • Assist customers in troubleshooting problems, diagnosing issues with software installation and applications, identifying root causes, and offering solutions.
  • Audit and debug source code to guide clients in configuring and customizing the Nuxeo platform to suit individual and progressive needs.
  • Interact with clients via our ticketing system, phone, video conference, email, or chat to ensure their issues are resolved in a timely manner, escalating issues as appropriate.
  • Partner with internal technical teams (product management, engineering, dev ops, and cloud ops) to resolve problems with configuration/code, software bugs, performance, and system failures.
  • Document the knowledge base of recurring issues. Take part in improving the documentation (after customer feedback) and/or fixing bugs to expedite the resolution of customers' issues and to avoid long wait times for fixes from the Dev team.

What will make you successful

  • Associate's degree or equivalent experience.
  • Fluent in English.
  • At least 2 years of experience in Technical Support or Software Development.
  • Ability to learn with an interest and aptitude for technology.
  • Familiarity with .NET programming or equivalent language experience.
  • Ability to work through a problem effectively and provide a solution.
  • Ability to work in a flexible and fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to effectively communicate technical concepts both in writing and verbally.
  • Ability to provide customer service and demonstrate strong follow-through.
  • Up to 10% travel time required.
  • Solid technical background in development:
    • Java
    • JavaScript: Nuxeo uses the Polymer framework.
    • Database: MongoDB and/or PostgreSQL (Oracle and MS SQL Server).
    • Docker and Kubernetes technologies.
    • Metrics analysis.
    • Cloud environment: mainly AWS (certification in Azure or GCP is desirable).
    • DataDog experience is desirable.
  • Good at communicating complex ideas and reaching out to different points of view.
  • Comfortable joining a call with a customer to investigate.
  • Participate in the after-hours on-call rotation. This may include late night or weekend availability. During on-call hours, you are paid regardless of whether any customer issues are handled or not.
  • A service-oriented mindset.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong attention to detail and extremely well-organized.
  • Positive can-do attitude.
  • Ability to work well with teams.

title: ENGENHEIRO (A) MASTER – PLANEJAMENTO TÁTICO – MINERAÇÃO
description:
ENGENHEIRO (A) MASTER – PLANEJAMENTO TÁTICO – MINERAÇÃO

Venha trabalhar com a gente e nos ajudar a fazer um novo futuro

Atenção: é necessário anexar seu currículo no ato da inscrição.

A triagem para o processo seletivo é realizada através da leitura do seu currículo anexado, caso já esteja anexado, lembre-se de manter o arquivo atualizado. Manter o currículo atualizado aumenta as suas chances de sucesso no processo seletivo.

A Vale coloca a vida em primeiro lugar e apoia todas as formas de proteção individual e coletiva da vida e saúde. Por isso, acreditamos na vacina como a melhor forma de combater a pandemia do COVID19. Vacinar-se é a maneira mais segura de conter a pandemia. De acordo com o Plano Nacional de Imunização (PNI), do Governo Federal, todos os brasileiros e as brasileiras deverão tomar a vacina.

Todos os imunizantes disponíveis passaram por criteriosos testes antes de serem aplicados nas pessoas. Além disso, os resultados positivos só comprovam a eficácia. Mais de 91 milhões de pessoas no país estão totalmente vacinadas ao tomar a segunda dose ou a dose única de imunizantes.

Solicitamos aos trabalhadores e as trabalhadoras que se vacinem contra a COVID-19 e que apresentem o cartão de vacinação com os dados do imunizante, ou carteira de vacinação digital gerada pelo Conecte SUS. É responsabilidade de todos nós cuidar da proteção da nossa saúde e daqueles que nos rodeiam, dentro e fora da empresa. Fique ciente, a proteção da vida é um valor inegociável para a Vale, e por isso ao longo do processo seletivo essa solicitação será feita a você.

A vacinação é um ato coletivo. Quando você se vacina, você também protege quem está à sua volta e contribui para a diminuição de casos.

Juntos, a gente transforma o futuro

Somos a maior mineradora do mundo em minério de ferro, pelotas e níquel. Empregamos mais de 120 mil pessoas em 30 países. Também atuamos nas áreas de logística, energia e siderurgia. E estamos trabalhando para a Vale ser referência em segurança e líder em desenvolvimento sustentável. Porque a gente acredita que a mineração é essencial para o desenvolvimento do mundo e precisamos deixar um legado para o meio ambiente, para as comunidades em que estamos e para todas as vidas que tocamos.

O jeito de ser da Vale

A Vale está sempre mudando. A gente transforma o minério. A gente transforma o país. Porque o mais importante, para nós, são as pessoas. Sem elas, não vamos conseguir alcançar o futuro que a gente quer. Esse é o jeito de ser da Vale, a nossa razão de existir: melhorar a vida e transformar o futuro. E temos de fazer isso juntos, aprendendo todos os dias.

Por que a Vale?

Porque aqui existem muitas possibilidades para você:

Estamos em 5 estados brasileiros em 3 regiões diferentes

Você tem a oportunidade de ter uma experiência global, trabalhar em diferentes regiões do país e do mundo.

Somos uma empresa cada vez mais inclusiva e com oportunidades abertas para todos, sem distinção.

Incentivamos a participação de mulheres, negras, negros, LGBTQIA+ e PcDs no processo seletivo.

Estamos entre as 10 empresas dos sonhos dos jovens e na visão dos gestores, para se trabalhar.

Criamos para os nossos colaboradores um portfólio de treinamentos e capacitações técnicas, de gestão e de liderança ou transversais. Acreditamos em quem faz a nossa empresa.

O nosso papel é melhorar a vida. Entre nossas principais metas estão diminuir o consumo de água, reduzir as emissões de carbono – para a Vale se tornar carbono neutra até 2050 –, recuperar florestas, produzir 100% de energia limpa.

Quer conhecer nossa oportunidade?

Formação: Formação em engenharia de minas ou correlatas.

Localidade : Canaã dos Carajás , Pará , Brasil

Horário de Trabalho: Turno Diurno

Período de inscrição: de 19 /06/2023 a 25/06/2023

O que precisamos que você tenha obrigatoriamente:

  • Visão sistêmica do planejamento de mina em todos os horizontes;
  • Experiência com planejamento de lavra;

O que desejamos que você apresente :

  • Experiência com cobre ou ouro;
  • Desejável experiência em processos de definição orçamentária;
  • Experiência em controle de custos;
  • Experiência com atualização anual de recursos e reservas, pit design e sequenciamento do LOM será um diferencial.
  • Gerar cenários de sequenciamento de lavra;
  • Responsável pela elaboração dos planos nos horizontes D+30, D+90 e M+24;
  • Acompanhamento e elaboração de projetos executivos dentro do cenário dos 24 meses;
  • Elaborar design das cavas e pilhas de estéril;
  • Desdobrar os objetivos e contexto de negócio para o Planejamento de Lavra na elaboração dos ciclos de planejamento;
  • Buscar oportunidades dentro dos planos de lavra;
  • Validar os planos de mina definidos para os ciclos estratégico e orçamentário;
  • Elaborar todos os elementos da Programação Operacional, nos horizontes semanal, mensal e anual, necessárias para a execução as atividades de Infraestrutura de mina e atividades de manutenção ambiental;
  • Assegurar a programação das atividades de conservação e desenvolvimento de infraestrutura da mina de acordo com diretrizes dos planos (ex: drenagem, vias de acesso, projetos de cava e pilha, etc);
  • Garantir os alinhamentos e a interface com a áreas operacional e com as geotecnia para desdobrar o programa operacional (plano de chuvas, plano DBG);
  • Selecionar e dimensionar e equipamentos de infraestrutura de mina;
  • Atuar como suporte técnico às áreas operacionais e demais horizontes de planejamento de lavra, conforme solicitado.

Um pouco do que a Vale oferece para você

  • Previdência Privada
  • PLR - Programa de Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Reembolso Creche ou Auxílio Babá para empregadas
  • Assistência Médica e Hospitalar, Odontológica, farmacológica e vacinas para prevenção de doenças Infectocontagiosas
  • PASA - Plan os de saúde para familiares de empregados ou para o próprio empregado, em caso de aposentadoria ou desligamento
  • Seguro de Vida em Grupo
  • Apoiar - Programa de Assistência ao Empregado e seus dependentes.
  • Vale alimentação
  • Vale refeição ou Refeições no trabalho concedidas em restaurantes industriais
  • Vale alimentação extra para o Natal
  • Cartão presente no final do ano para Dependentes, filhos, enteados e menores sob guarda com até 10 anos
  • Transporte fretado ou Vale transporte.
  • Passagens no trem de passageiros na Estrada de Ferro Vitória a Minas (EFVM) e/ou na Estrada de Ferro Carajás (EFC).
  • Desconto para aluguel de carros

Entre outros ...

Seja você!

Quanto mais pessoas com visões diferentes, outros pontos de vista, mais a Vale evolui. Toda pessoa tem de ser ouvida, e ter a mesma oportunidade de se desenvolver aqui dentro. Essa é a verdadeira inclusão.

O que realmente importa é trabalhar com gente que quer fazer as coisas acontecerem. Queremos conhecer o seu potencial. Queremos protagonistas. Alguém que quer sempre aprender, correr atrás dos seus objetivos, gosta de desafios e tem um espírito colaborativo. Sentimos muito orgulho de estimular o crescimento de quem trabalha aqui conosco. Porque o desenvolvimento e a qualificação dos nossos colaboradores e colaboradoras são fundamentais para a nossa transformação cultural. A gente dá as ferramentas, mas é você que vai construir a sua carreira.

Oportunidades para todas as pessoas

Você sabe a diferença entre diversidade e inclusão? Diversidade significa ter, no ambiente de trabalho, pessoas de todas as raças, credos, cores, religiões, culturas, orientações sexuais, características físicas. Inclusão é dar real espaço para todas as pessoas se desenvolverem na carreira, com equidade e oportunidades para qualquer cargo. Trabalhamos para construir um ambiente em que todos e todas se sintam aceitos e respeitados.

Aqui na Vale temos o compromisso de garantir um ambiente de trabalho diverso e inclusivo.

Todas as oportunidades estão abertas para pessoas com deficiência (PcD) e reabilitados do INSS.

description:
Com um legado único em dermatologia e décadas de inovação de ponta, a Galderma é a líder emergente na categoria de dermatologia, presente em aproximadamente 90 países. Oferecemos um portfólio inovador baseado na ciência de marcas premium e serviços que abrangem todo o espectro do mercado de dermatologia em rápido crescimento através de Estética Injetável, Cuidados Dermatológicos e Dermatologia Terapêutica. Desde a nossa fundação em 1981, dedicamos nossa atenção e paixão ao maior órgão do corpo humano - a pele - atendendo às necessidades individuais de consumidores e pacientes com resultados superiores em parceria com profissionais de saúde. Porque entendemos que a pele em que estamos molda nossas vidas, estamos avançando na dermatologia para cada história de pele.

Procuramos pessoas que se concentrem em obter resultados, abracem a aprendizagem e tragam uma energia positiva. Elas devem combinar iniciativa com um senso de trabalho em equipe e colaboração. Acima de tudo, devem estar apaixonadas por fazer algo significativo para os consumidores, pacientes e profissionais de saúde que atendemos todos os dias. Nosso objetivo é capacitar cada funcionário e promover seu crescimento pessoal, garantindo ao mesmo tempo que as necessidades comerciais sejam atendidas agora e no futuro. Em toda a nossa empresa, abraçamos a diversidade e respeitamos a dignidade, a privacidade e os direitos pessoais de cada funcionário.

Na Galderma, damos ativamente às nossas equipes motivos para acreditar em nossa ousada ambição de nos tornarmos a principal empresa de dermatologia do mundo. Com a gente, você tem a oportunidade definitiva de adquirir novas e desafiadoras experiências de trabalho e criar um impacto direto incomparável.

Sobre a Galderma

A Galderma é a empresa líder na categoria dedicada à dermatologia, presente em aproximadamente 90 países. Fornecemos um portfólio inovador e baseado na ciência de marcas e serviços premium que abrangem todo o espectro do mercado de dermatologia em rápido crescimento, por meio de Estética Injetável, Dermocosméticos e Dermatologia Terapêutica. Desde nossa fundação em 1981, dedicamos nosso foco e paixão ao maior órgão do corpo humano – a pele – atendendo às necessidades individuais de consumidores e pacientes com resultados superiores em parceria com profissionais de saúde. Estamos avançando a dermatologia para cada história de pele, porque entendemos que a pele em que estamos molda nossas histórias de vida.

Trabalhar na Galderma

Na Galderma, você terá a oportunidade definitiva de obter experiências de trabalho transformadoras. Estamos comprometidos em atender às necessidades individuais de consumidores e pacientes, com resultados superiores, em parceria com profissionais de saúde.

Em nossa empresa, abraçamos as diferenças e respeitamos a diversidade, a privacidade e os direitos pessoais de cada funcionário. Temos o compromisso de manter nosso local de trabalho respeitoso e inclusivo. Temos orgulho de nossa dedicação à diversidade e inclusão e queremos garantir que as pessoas com quem fazemos negócios conheçam, compartilhem e respeitem nossos padrões.

Se você busca colocar suas ideias em prática, fazer a diferença e exercer o seu propósito, seu lugar é aqui.

Oportunidade – Principais Responsabilidades

O que você vai fazer:

  • Atuará na BU Skin Care Dermatológico e Dermatologia Terapêutica.
  • Implementação e desenvolvimento de programas de treinamentos baseados nas competências funcionais e aprimoramento das habilidades em vendas.

  • Monitorar prazos e coordenar interface entre Treinamento e Marketing visando ao cumprimento do cronograma do Plano de Treinamento anual e demais atividades de Treinamento;
  • Coordenação e desenvolvimento da especialista de treinamento comercial.
  • Organizar e coordenar, juntamente com as demais áreas envolvidas, as atividades nas Convenções, reuniões Estratégicas, Reuniões Regionais e Cursos de Novos;
  • Acompanhar e avaliar os indicadores das atividades de treinamento e as performances da Força de Vendas no que tange a esses indicadores.

  • Domínio e utilização de práticas de facilitação de aprendizagem, metodologias e soluções em treinamento;

title: Inspetor (a) de Qualidade
description:
Verificar se o conjunto de peças do selo mecânico está de acordo com o desenho técnico através da análise e verificação dimensional da peça.

Revisar o acabamento da peça através da designação de um profissional para retrabalhar o acabamento, caso não tenha sido aprovada pela área de qualidade.

Comunicar rejeições de peças através de contato com PCP e Engenharia que poderão confirmar a reprovação e recomendar a aferição de recuperação.

Executar a gravação do logo e número da Ordem de Fabricação na peça através do processo realizado na máquina a laser.

Verificar a gravação física na sobreposta e a gravação química no selo através do selo montado.

Verificar a ordem de montagem e aprova se estiver de acordo registrando no sistema através da confirmação de nenhuma falha física e se a ordem está assinada pelo montador.

Aprovar o lote inicial de peças produzidas no CNC, para dar continuidade na produção sem risco de erro.

Analisar materiais comprados, peça ou ferramenta através do desenho técnico ou especificações.

Analisar a aplicação nas peças de materiais por terceiros através da aplicação de teste químico, via teste de líquido penetrante, observando a coloração da peça após a aplicação.

Emitir o relatório semanal de ocorrências abrangendo peças rejeitadas, retrabalhos e não anotação pelo operador da medida “R” na Ordem de Fabricação.

Controlar a calibração dos equipamentos de medição abrangendo parquímetros, micrometros e demais instrumentos de medições , recomendando o seu envio para ajuste da calibração e manutenção por terceiros.

Verificar semanalmente os parquímetros da fábrica em comparação com a medida padrão, registrando em planilha os desvios observados.

Verificar no recebimento de materiais a composição química em comparação com as especificações do pedido, identificando possíveis não conformidades no material recebido.

Realizar a limpeza geral das peças aprovadas através da máquina de ultrassom.

Realizar o processo de controle de cura das peças em borracha através da estufa de cura.
